features.name: local_first_issue_tracking
features.description: Stores issue state locally in SQLite with git-friendly JSONL export.

features.name: agent_machine_output
features.description: Read-side commands expose JSON, TOON, or documented robot surfaces.

features.name: schema_export
features.description: br schema emits JSON schemas and command envelope shapes.

features.name: coordination_diagnostics
features.description: br coordination status diagnoses hidden or stale in-progress claims.

features.name: mcp_stdio_optional
features.description: Binaries built with the mcp feature can serve a stdio MCP API.

commands.name: audit
commands.summary: Record and label agent interactions (append-only JSONL)

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: Describe br's machine-readable contracts and safety guarantees

commands.name: capacity
commands.summary: Workflow capacity management: audited issue-specific exemptions (GitHub #384)
examples: br capacity exempt br-abc --status in_progress --provider operator --reason incident --expires +1h --json

commands.name: close
examples: br close br-abc --agent-name Codex --model gpt-5 --harness local --json

commands.name: coordination
commands.summary: Diagnose swarm coordination state without mutating claims

commands.name: create
examples: br create --title "Investigate slow ready" --slug slow-ready --labels perf,agent-workflow --json

commands.name: dep
examples: br dep add br-task br-blocker --type blocks --json
br dep list br-task --direction both --format json

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Run diagnostics and optionally repair issues

commands.name: gate
commands.summary: Workflow gate engine: record and inspect gate results (issue #312)
examples: br gate report br-abc --gate ci_green --provider ci --status pass --to in_progress --json

commands.name: graph
commands.summary: Visualize the dependents graph: what an issue unblocks

commands.name: info
commands.summary: Show diagnostic metadata about the workspace

commands.name: lint
commands.summary: Check issues for missing template sections

commands.name: orphans
commands.summary: List orphan issues (referenced in commits but open)

commands.name: q
commands.summary: Quick capture (create issue, print ID only)

commands.name: query
examples: br query save p0-open --priority 0 --status open --description "P0 open work" --format json
br query run p0-open --assignee agent-name --format json

commands.name: ready
commands.summary: List ready issues (open, unblocked, not deferred)

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.summary: Print concise in-tool docs for automation agents

commands.name: scheduler
commands.summary: Rank ready work for agent swarms with explainable evidence

commands.name: schema
commands.summary: Emit JSON Schemas and per-command output envelope shapes (for agent/tooling integration)

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search issues (matches title, description, id, and comment text)

commands.name: sync
commands.summary: Sync database with JSONL file (export or import)

commands.name: vcs-status
commands.summary: Explicitly inspect Git visibility for the configured JSONL export

commands.name: upgrade
commands.summary: Upgrade br to the latest version

global_flags.description: Request machine-readable JSON output when a command supports it.
Disable ANSI styling for human-readable output.
Override the discovered .beads SQLite database path.
Set the actor recorded in mutation audit events.

exit_codes.description: Database initialization, schema, or storage error.
Issue lookup, ambiguity, or issue-state error.
Invalid command input, flag value, or required field.
Dependency graph error such as a cycle or self-dependency.
JSONL import/export, merge, or sync safety error.

env_vars.name: BEADS_JSONL
env_vars.description: Override the JSONL path when explicitly allowed.

env_vars.name: BR_OUTPUT_FORMAT
env_vars.description: Default output format: text, json, or toon.

env_vars.name: TOON_DEFAULT_FORMAT
env_vars.description: Fallback default that can select TOON output.

env_vars.name: RUST_LOG
env_vars.description: Set logging verbosity; use RUST_LOG=error for routine agent runs.

safety.name: no_automatic_git_operations
safety.guarantee: br never commits, pushes, pulls, or installs hooks automatically.

safety.name: sync_path_allowlist
safety.guarantee: sync writes stay inside .beads unless an external JSONL path is explicitly allowed.

safety.name: write_lock_for_storage_mutations
safety.guarantee: mutating commands acquire the workspace write lock before storage writes.

safety.name: structured_errors
safety.guarantee: machine-output contexts render structured error envelopes on stdout; stderr carries diagnostics.
